title: Focus group Thursday Sept. 14 featuring Dr. Paul Titchenell
summary: On Thursday September 14, Dr. Paul Titchenell will present a seminar, "Redefining the Role of AKT Signaling in Muscle Growth and Metabolism".
bodyHtml:
Please join us on Thursday September 14 for our next KPN focus group, featuring guest speaker Paul Titchenell. Dr. Titchenell is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Physiology and the Institute for Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism at the University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia, PA. He is also a member of the AMP® CMD consortium that is generating genetic and genomic results to accelerate the development of new therapeutics for common diseases. In this webinar, he will present his work on redefining the role of AKT signaling in muscle growth and metabolism.

Details on joining the presentation are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate it to interested colleagues! We hope to see you there, but we’ll also record and post the presentation for those who can’t make it.

 

Knowledge Portal Network Focus Group
